newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Toll profit in line with forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Toll profit in line with forecasts.

text.p: Transport group Toll Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that its results for the September quarter were in line with budget and it expected profits for the first half to be in line with forecasts.

"Results for the first quarter are in line with plan and as indicated by the chairman, given no significant deterioration of the Australian economy and the continued rationalisation and assimilation of the Brambles acquisition, we expect the first half interim results to be in line with forecast results," managing director Paul Little told the annual meeting.
Little said Toll's strategic direction together with recent announcements by other major transport groups indicated that the Australian transport industry would continue to rationalise.
"This trend ... will have positive implications for Toll as we further establish the group as a unique provider of integrated transport solutions across all sectors," Little said.
He said excellent growth opportunities were available in the second half year through provision of specialised warehousing and distribution services to major Australian companies.
